reviews.text: Being a very anxious, dogmatic mother, especially over Mr. Joyau's minor ailments, I felt listened to and reassured by clear and precise explanations.

Nearly killed my cat with cortisone when his heart was dilated and he was drowning with water in his chest.

Extremely uncomfortably polite and unpleasant.

Given me back my cat with his mouth open, critically hyperventilating, telling me "he's just stressed" when he was literally choking.

Took my cat's temperature (36 degrees Celsius, which is extremely low, dangerous hypothermia) and said, "Oh, that's low... I must have taken the measurement wrong." She obviously didn't take it again to check.

After I told her all my concerns, including my cat losing a third of his weight, she just replied, "Oh, you know, he's an old cat."

That same day (because I had a strong feeling something was wrong), another veterinarian on Avenue de la République saw in 30 seconds that his condition was completely abnormal, that he had serious breathing problems, and that he needed to be hospitalized immediately.

In short, the VETINPARIS veterinarians are incompetent and even dangerous in their practice. Avoid them if you care about your pet!

This vet downplays potentially serious animal situations; avoid them at all costs! I recommend the one on Avenue de la République, who is much more professional! To make a long story short, we brought our cat in after he hadn't eaten for 5 days and had lost a third of his weight. Their response: "Oh, well, vitamin B12 should do the trick..." Spoiler alert: after seeing another vet the next day, he had a dilated heart, fluid in his rib cage, and was hospitalized urgently. :(

June 24, 2024!

Stars maintained 😁😁😁 Dr. Manenti is incredibly kind to both animals and their humans. Very efficient too. Lulu was comfortable and not at all stressed by the change of hands. A very warm welcome from the assistant; I'm renewing my trust in this clinic and its young team.

Thank you so much!

⚠️Reopening today, June 24, 2024

Please note this review concerns Dr. Donzé, who retired in December 2023. I don't yet know if his successor shares the same values, as the premises are still under construction in April.

A true vet, who loves animals, who doesn't treat owners condescendingly, and who cares for our beloved pets with gentleness and efficiency. A big plus: he doesn't try to sell you a bunch of stuff, like so many vets do these days. My cat was very relaxed, even though he's usually quite stressed.

I've made him my regular vet. It's a shame he's leaving in December 2023.

Our cat was examined by Dr. Manenti, who is fantastic! He listens attentively, takes his time, and explains everything clearly. He knows how to adapt the examination to each animal. He advised us on the different treatment options available for our pet.

Thank you so much!

After a very pleasant welcome, the consultation and hydrotherapy session began. Everything went very well. Dr. Manenti was kind and patient with my dog, who didn't like water.

After a severe case of tendonitis and several weeks of lameness, we are finally seeing the light at the end of the tunnel. The lameness has stopped, and Cannelle is starting to walk better.

A big thank you!

We adopted Gallia, a 13-year-old dog, from the animal shelter three weeks ago. She was suffering from acute kidney failure, and from the very first appointment, Mr. Manenti explained the situation to us with great professionalism, honesty, and above all, humanity, telling us that she unfortunately didn't have much time left to live. This news was very difficult for our whole family to accept, but we were deeply touched by his gentleness, kindness, and the way he took the time to listen to us and support us.
Two days earlier, when Gallia's condition deteriorated significantly and we had to make the heartbreaking decision to let her go, Mr. Manenti once again demonstrated immense respect, compassion, and great sensitivity, both towards our dog and towards us. We truly feel that he is a passionate veterinarian who deeply loves his profession and animals, and who places the well-being of all at the heart of his practice. We felt listened to, understood, and supported during an extremely difficult time. A humane, competent, and deeply caring veterinarian whom I recommend without hesitation.

I took my dog ​​to this clinic for an anal abscess. The abscess was drained, but the anal glands weren't expressed or properly treated.

This incomplete treatment caused my dog ​​significant suffering, with severe pain, swelling, and considerable discomfort for several days.

I eventually went to another clinic, where the veterinarian immediately expressed the anal glands. By the next day, my dog ​​was back to normal.

Given the avoidable suffering my dog ​​endured, I cannot recommend this clinic.

They also helped to reach out to animal associations that could help me find her foster home.

Definitely recommend, especially if it’s an animal in need or urgent help, as I booked the appointment the night before and they were available on Saturdays.

Originally a client of Dr. Donzé, I was unfortunately upset when he retired. He always took care of my animals until he stopped... After informing me that his practice was being taken over and that his successor would be practicing in the same way, I was a little apprehensive about meeting Dr. Manenti (out of fear...).

In the end, I'm not disappointed at all! Dr. Manenti takes exactly the time needed to examine, explain, and reassure both the animal and the owner, putting them at ease (just as Dr. Donzé had explained to me at the beginning, and also what he did).

The assistant I spoke to on the phone several times, as well as her colleagues, are also very pleasant and take the time to answer questions, explain things, reassure me, and take notes to pass on to the doctor.

Furthermore, they are easily reachable by phone, and even if there's a wait (very rarely) and you really want to be reassured, then yes, it's worth the wait because they will take the time to answer all your questions, concerns, etc.

My opinion is purely personal because, having had several veterinarians in the past who weren't very empathetic, it's hard to trust someone else.

I thank them very much for the time they give me by phone and in person. It's not easy when your pet isn't well, and neither are you.

Having visited in 2024, my opinion remains valid, and I wouldn't change it for anything.

Gentleness, kindness, and competence: from the veterinary nurses to the veterinarians, everything in this clinic exudes a love for animals. Rare enough to be worth mentioning… kudos to Dr. Manenti and his team!

Dr. Manenti and his team are fantastic. For the past five months, Dr. Manenti has been fighting alongside me to help my cat Georges, who was paralyzed at stage 5, recover. Thanks to his extremely effective physiotherapy equipment and his perfect mastery, dedication, and 100% commitment at every session, he managed to get Georges walking again in just three months, using a reflex gait! My cat could only use his two front paws to get around. Now, he walks on all fours every day, he jumps on the sofa and the bed, and he can go up and down stairs on his own! He has regained his independence! Dear Dr. Manenti, thank you so much for this incredible work. For believing in him, for trying everything! Thank you also to your kind and wonderful assistants for being so caring, welcoming, and happy to see the progress. A rare and precious clinic where consideration, compassion, and courage are ever-present.
